title: All tests hardcode ephemeral absolute data paths instead of ./data/kaggle
evidence: internal/store/store_test.go:9 and internal/server/server_test.go:11 pass /Users/adriancockcroft/.retort/work/retort-local-0xabe5kx/retort-*/data/kaggle to store.LoadData (32 occurrences); the archive ships data at ./data/kaggle. On any other machine or after work-dir cleanup, LoadData errors and t.Fatalf fails every test — R12 verification only holds on the original run's temp dir.
suggestion: Load from a relative path (e.g. filepath.Join("..","..","data","kaggle")) or a testdata dir shipped with the code so tests are reproducible.

title: CalculateLeagueStandings conflates Brasileirao and historical datasets
evidence: internal/store/database.go:353 skips a match only when isCorrectCompetition is false AND match.Tournament != "". The Brasileirao_Matches and novo_campeonato_brasileiro loaders never set Tournament, so both files' matches are counted for any competition/season — a 2019 Brasileirao team can be counted across two overlapping datasets, inflating matches/points.
suggestion: Tag each match with its source competition at load time and filter standings on that tag rather than a substring/empty-Tournament fallback.

title: GetTeamStats(team, 0) drops all seasoned matches
evidence: internal/store/database.go:209 `if match.Season > 0 && match.Season != season` with season=0 skips every match that has a season set, leaving only Season==0 rows (BR-Football/Libertadores). CompareTeams (soccer_server.go:114) calls GetTeamStats(team, 0), so team comparison stats are near-empty.
suggestion: Treat season==0 as 'all seasons' in GetTeamStats (only filter when season > 0), matching FindMatchesByTeam's convention.

title: Most tests print instead of asserting
evidence: Of 32 test functions only ~13 contain a behavioural t.Error/t.Fatal beyond the load-error guard; e.g. server_test.go:10 TestSoccerServerFindMatchesByTeam, :137 GetAverageGoalsPerMatch, :322 FindMatchesBySeason, :335 FindMatchesByCompetition just fmt.Printf results without checking them.
suggestion: Add assertions on returned counts/values so the tests actually exercise (not merely execute) the query capabilities.

title: format*Text helpers duplicated across packages
evidence: The six format*Text functions in cmd/main.go:340-426 are copied verbatim into internal/server/server.go:10-96; the server.go copy exists only to satisfy server_test.go.
suggestion: Move the formatters to one exported location (e.g. internal/server) and call them from cmd/main.go.

title: TestFormatPlayerText conditionally skips when player not found
evidence: internal/server/server_test.go:294 t.Skip("Player not found") — the test silently skips instead of failing if the FIFA data lookup for Neymar returns nil.
suggestion: Assert the player is found (t.Fatal on nil) so a data-loading regression is caught rather than hidden.
